title: gagea lutea
intro: Gagea lutea, commonly known as the yellow gagea or yellow star of Bethlehem, is a perennial plant species in the lily family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Gagea lutea include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders, as well as its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which can help to alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Gagea lutea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
